summary: Feature implemented by reading and editing only; nothing was run, so tests and flake8 are unverified. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver), plot_2d_or_3d_image in monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py, and changed the NIfTI writer default dtype to np.float32. Rewrote SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver (adds filename, engine-accepting completion wrapper) and TensorBoardImageHandler (adds index) as thin adapters. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. Added tests test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and updated test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Line lengths, trailing newlines, and unused imports were checked by reading only. Nothing was committed. Highest-risk items to verify when tests run: the overwrite-false CSV merge test, the EventAccumulator tag assertions in the plot tests, and the classification handler attach on pytorch-ignite 0.3.0.
